name: Red Mulberry

facts.how: Raw by the handful, pie, jam

caution: Eat only fully ripe (dark) berries; unripe white-and-green fruit and the milky sap can upset the stomach. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Harvesting
sections.body: Spread a sheet and shake the branches: ripe mulberries rain down and stain everything a cheerful purple. Wash and use quickly, as they don't keep.

sections.title: In the kitchen
sections.body: Sweet and mild, a little flat on their own, so cooks brighten them with lemon in pies and jams.
